name: Santa Rosa CityBus
description: Free rides for youth, children, veterans, SRJC students, paratransit users, and City of Santa Rosa/County of Sonoma employees
fullDescription: Santa Rosa CityBus provides local public transit service throughout the City of Santa Rosa in Sonoma County, with multiple routes connecting neighborhoods, schools, shopping, and employment centers.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free rides for youth ages 5-18 and children 4 and under
- Free rides for veterans with qualifying ID
- Free rides for Santa Rosa Junior College students with valid student ID
- Free rides for paratransit users with a valid paratransit ID
- Free rides for City of Santa Rosa and County of Sonoma employees
- Half fare ($0.75) for seniors 65+, people with disabilities, and Medicare card holders
howToGetIt:
1. Youth: Show a school ID or DMV-issued ID (high school age); schools without IDs can provide a special pass
2. Veterans: Show a VA ID card, Sonoma County Veterans ID card, or California driver's license with veteran designation
3. SRJC Students: Show current student ID
4. City/County Employees: Show proof of employment
5. No separate application needed—just show ID when boarding
keywords: Santa Rosa CityBus, free bus, youth, veterans, SRJC, Santa Rosa Junior College, Sonoma County, transit
